    • composeTwoWidgetsHorizontally

      public static WidgetTUI composeTwoWidgetsHorizontally(WidgetTUI mainWidget, WidgetTUI donorWidget)
      Composes two widgets horizontally by returning the main widget with its screen replaced with the horizontal composition of the given widgets' screens.
      Parameters:
      mainWidget - The main widget onto which the composition result will be placed on
      donorWidget - The donor widget whose screen will be put inside the main widget
      Returns:
      The widget resulting from the composition of the two given widgets

    • composeWidgetsHorizontally

      public static WidgetTUI composeWidgetsHorizontally(List<WidgetTUI> widgets)
      Parameters:
      widgets - The widgets that will be composed horizontally into one (NOTE: The given widgets will be composed IN THE GIVEN ORDER)
      Returns:
      A widget whose screen is the result of the horizontal composition of the given widget list

    • composeTwoWidgetsVertically

      public static WidgetTUI composeTwoWidgetsVertically(WidgetTUI mainWidget, WidgetTUI donorWidget)
      Composes two widgets vertically by returning the main widget with its screen replaced with the vertical composition of the given widgets' screens.
      Parameters:
      mainWidget - The main widget onto which the composition result will be placed on
      donorWidget - The donor widget whose screen will be put inside the main widget
      Returns:
      The widget resulting from the composition of the two given widgets

    • composeWidgetsVertically

      Parameters:
      widgets - The widgets that will be composed vertically into one
      (NOTE: The given widgets will be composed IN THE GIVEN ORDER)
      Returns:
      A widget whose screen is the result of the vertical composition of the given widget list

    • composeScreensHorizontally

      public static List<String> composeScreensHorizontally(List<List<String>> screens)
      Parameters:
      screens - The widget's screens to compose horizontally
      Returns:
      A single screen containing the horizontal composition result, which is done by first taking all the strings from each string list that are at a certain index/height, then they are all concatenated (in order of how they're provided) and this creates the i-th line. Repeat this process until all lists have been stitched together and you get the resulting composition (NOTE: If some screens are of different heights, then the shorter ones are compensated by adding empty lines)

    • composeScreensVertically

      public static List<String> composeScreensVertically(List<List<String>> screens)
      Parameters:
      screens - The widget's screens to compose vertically
      Returns:
      A single screen containing the vertical composition result, which is done by concatenating each of the given string lists into a single one

    • addPadding

      public WidgetTUI addPadding(int top, int right, int bottom, int left)
      Adds the given amount of padding spaces for each side. The idea is to follow the HTML box model, thus this method works just like adding padding pixels in CSS to an HTML tag
      Parameters:
      top - The amount of padding to add to the top of this widget's screen
      right - The amount of padding to add to the right of this widget's screen
      bottom - The amount of padding to add to the bottom of this widget's screen
      left - The amount of padding to add to the left of this widget's scren
